A: Style3D Fabric helps digitize textiles into realistic 3D digital materials. It captures visual texture and physical behavior for accurate garment simulation, and enables digital material editing. Q: Which fabric data matters most? A: Texture, color, thickness, stretch, shear, bending, and drape all affect digital fabric realism.
